join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!filter messagelength
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!filter messagelength
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter messagelength what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter messagelength <length>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter messagelength
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Max message length set to 500.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter messagelength 10
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Max message length set to 10.
